description: A Go CLI's release procedure: a reusable procedure stored twice, an operator constraint, a changed signing scheme and a wrong lesson that review marked as hurting.

memories.text: Release procedure: bump VERSION, move the Unreleased section of CHANGELOG.md under the new version, then push a vX.Y.Z tag; the release workflow builds and publishes the archives.
To cut a release edit VERSION and CHANGELOG.md, then push a tag like v2.3.0; CI then builds the release archives and publishes them.
Releases are patch bumps (x.y.z+1) unless the maintainer asks for a minor or major release.
Cross-compilation targets are listed in .goreleaser.yaml under builds.targets; a new platform is added there and nowhere else.
Release archives are signed with the project's GPG key 0x5A1B2C3D; verify a download with gpg --verify.
Release archives are signed with cosign keyless signing; verify with cosign verify-blob and the published .sig and .pem files. GPG signing was dropped.
Push release tags with git push --force so the workflow re-runs when a tag already exists.
The v2.3.1 release workflow had to be re-run once because the macOS runner timed out after 45 minutes.
Tagged v2.3.1 at commit 9e41d07 and the release page went live at 14:20.
